name: Raesfeld (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Raesfeld (a tower and red squirrels on yellow and red).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident of 30 April 1979 the municipality was granted the right to bear arms, an official seal and a banner, and by deed of 30 October 1986 additionally a flag; the banner is red, yellow and red striped 1:3:1 with the arms in the middle of the upper half.
